headings.strategy: Serif font to exude luxury, authority, and elegance. Font weight contrast (Black vs Light).

body.strategy: Clean, sterile mono-like body for technical data analyst context, ensuring high readability for dense analytics.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient golden glows for interactive elements (e.g., box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.15))
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid rgba(212, 175, 55, 0.2) for cards and sections to provide a premium feel
visual_enhancers.gradients: Subtle dark gradients (e.g., from #050505 to #0A0A0A) for backgrounds, no loud neon gradients
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 0.03) to break digital flatness and add high-end tactile feel

layouts.spacing: Generous padding (p-8 to p-16) for breathing room. High density grids (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3) for project showcases.
layouts.cards: Flat background (#0F0F0F) with 1px gold-tinted subtle border, no heavy box shadows by default, subtle lift on hover.
layouts.alignment: Left-aligned for paragraphs and dense data descriptions. Center-aligned for hero and major section titles.

motion.hover_states: Subtle -translate-y-1, border color darkens/lightens, and ambient shadow increases.
motion.transitions: Specific transitions for transform and opacity (e.g., transition: transform 0.3s ease, border-color 0.3s ease).
motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up animations for project grids using framer-motion.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast against #050505 background meets WCAG AA standards.
accessibility.focus: Focus states must have 2px gold ring offset by 2px dark background.
accessibility.aria: Use aria-hidden='true' for decorative visual enhancements. Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.

project_retail.description: Retail/sales performance dashboard screenshot with KPI cards and charts in a dark UI, representing Power BI.

project_churn.description: Customer churn analytics dashboard showing dark UI grid of metrics and data cards.

project_stock.description: Stock market analysis dashboard with multiple chart panels and candlestick charts, designed to look like a Power BI interface.

hero_avatar.description: Custom three.js anime-inspired hero avatar with drag-to-rotate interaction. Note: Do NOT use Spline.
hero_avatar.implementation: Use @react-three/fiber and @react-three/drei (OrbitControls for drag-to-rotate) to render the 3D avatar.

instructions_to_main_agent: Design a responsive portfolio for a Data Analyst showcasing SQL, Power BI, Excel, and Python skills.
Strictly follow the luxury dark theme (Obsidian #050505 and Gold #D4AF37).
Use the updated image URLs for the projects to show realistic, intermediate-level dashboard analytics in a dark interface.
Integrate the 3D hero avatar using @react-three/fiber (not Spline).
Use Playfair Display for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body text to contrast luxury with technical precision.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or headers overlaying content.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetic. Create distinctive and creative frontend interfaces.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Avoid generic centered layouts and uniform styling. Create depth with z-index hierarchy and layered design.
Use glass-morphism (12-24px blur) where appropriate for overlapping elements, but ensure text contrast.
Do not apply universal transition 'transition: all'. Explicitly state transitions like 'transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease'.
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). Keep natural reading flow (left-aligned).
Use modern button styles (e.g., crisp rectangular with subtle gold border or pill-shaped).
Never use emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡 for icons. Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide React.
Use provided image_urls. Do not use placeholder text for missing images.
Use sonner for toasts, and shadcn components for UI logic, customizing them to fit the luxury-dark brand.
